scope: Post-selection engineering audit on five deterministic TRAIN structures; no target values or retrospective structures read; no model or selection modification.
selection_rule: First 3 ordered and first 2 disordered TRAIN material IDs in ascending lexical order, each with n_sites<=50, classified from actual site species and occupancies.
interpretation: Five structures and four transformations do not prove universal representation invariance.
The regenerated-original control checks reconstructed inputs; it is not a separate physical invariance.
A 2x1x1 supercell represents the same periodic material, but raw site count, cell volume, lattice-vector ratios and minimum-image pair-table multiplicities may change.
Every transformed structure receives newly computed 6 A periodic neighbors; all species and absolute occupancies are retained.
Cutoff-boundary edges and near-zero variance may differ because of numerical rounding.
General lattice basis changes, all supercell choices and all rotations are outside this finite audit.
Missingness changes and failures remain in this report and do not alter already frozen predictive results.
The audit gives no new predictive, causal, mechanistic or independent-cohort evidence.
